newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand sets baht reference rate at 28.578.
newsitem.headline: Thailand sets baht reference rate at 28.578.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said it set an average interbank exchange rate of 28.578 baht per dollar on Monday, versus 28.189 baht on Friday.
The reference rate is announced daily by the central bank after last Wednesday's managed flotation of the baht.
The daily reference rate is based on the baht's traded average on the previous business day.
The baht was trading at 28.700 to the dollar in the offshore market and 28.550 in the local market after the rate was issued.
The central bank said it has an "appropriate rate" in mind and will intervene accordingly if the baht deviated much from that level.
